com.ibm.cos.v2.auth.credentials.ibmOAuth

Interface IBMOAuthCredentials

  • All Superinterfaces:
    AwsCredentials, AwsCredentialsIdentity, IBMOAuthIdentity, Identity
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    BasicIBMOAuthCredentials

    public interface IBMOAuthCredentials
extends AwsCredentials, IBMOAuthIdentity
    IBM OAuth Credentials interface. This interface extends AwsCredentials and IBMOAuthIdentity and provides methods to get the API key and service instance ID.
